name: BPROP
recent: Berjaya Property 公布2026财年首季业绩，净利按年大增逾七倍至RM41m，营收RM1.89b。公司正推进以RM50m收购Manjaran Sdn Bhd 20%股权，并拟认购额外29%股权，相关先决条件期限已延至2027年3月31日。此外，公司将于2026年12月9日召开第36届常年股东大会。
notable: Bursa已批准发行178,571,429股新股作为部分对价。
先决条件期限延长至2027年3月31日。
2026财年首季净利按年增长逾七倍至RM41m，营收RM1.89b。
risks: 收购Manjaran 20%股权涉及发行178,571,429股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司须在发行对价股份后遵守20%的较低公众持股比例要求。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收RM1,922.7m，净利RM1.8m，净利率0.1%，较上期净利率-3.7%转正；营收环比增长4.8%。

recent_en: Berjaya Property reported 1QFY2026 net profit surging more than sevenfold year-on-year to RM41m on revenue of RM1.89b. The company is proceeding with the RM50m acquisition of a 20% stake in Manjaran Sdn Bhd and a proposed subscription of an additional 29% stake, with the conditions precedent period extended to 31 March 2027. The 36th Annual General Meeting is scheduled for 9 December 2026.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of a 20% stake in Manjaran Sdn Bhd for RM50m, with Bursa approving the listing of 178,571,429 new shares as part consideration.
Proposed subscription of 2.32 million new shares (29% stake) in Manjaran Sdn Bhd, with the conditions precedent period extended to 31 March 2027.
1QFY2026 net profit rose more than sevenfold year-on-year to RM41m on revenue of RM1.89b.
risks_en: The acquisition of a 20% stake in Manjaran involves the issuance of 178,571,429 new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
The company must comply with a lower public shareholding spread of 20% upon listing of the consideration shares.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM1,922.7m with net profit of RM1.8m and net margin of 0.1%, turning positive from -3.7% in the prior period; revenue grew 4.8% quarter-on-quarter.
